title: Inhibitory mechanism of pterostilbene and pinostilbene on aldose reductase and α-glucosidase: a new insight from inhibition kinetics and molecular docking studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25579-25585
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03002A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lili Jiang, Yanyan Jia, Hang Yin, Yong Liu
Not pterostilbene but its metabolite (pinostilbene) exhibited a strong non-competitive inhibition on aldose reductase or α-glucosidase. Our data will provide comprehensive reference for the anti-diabetic mechanism of pterostilbene.
